property_summary: For any caller and deposited amount, calling withdrawBalance always results in the contract sending the caller the full balance that existed at the start of withdrawBalance (so after the call completes the caller's received amount equals their prior balance); the mutant zeros first and uses userBalance[msg.sender] when sending, allowing a reentrant/observing callee to cause the sent value to be different (e.g., 0) and thus violate this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Delete the temporary variable assignment so the call sends 0 (since tmp__1 is not set) — here we instead remove the tmp__1 assignment and use userBalance[msg.sender] directly in the call, changing timing and value sent.
